query: /expedition discuss v0.3.x  (an item Q14 is open in chat with its options; the owner then writes: "hm, option one looks right. would that also change the export button?")
expected_behavior: Answers the question about the export button in chat
Writes nothing to a plan file in that turn: no queue/item.py call with D, --move or --fact, no edit of decisions.md, queue.md or a spec
Does not treat the picked option as a recorded decision, because the message holds a question mark
Posts the item again with the new point folded in and waits for the owner's explicit word ("record it" or "accepted")
Does not post the next item of the queue

query: /expedition discuss v0.3.x  (spec 27 Sidebar is in progress in a running epic; the owner writes two remarks: "the sidebar menu loses its blur when it scrolls" and "we also need a billing area with its own pages"; after discussion the owner says "record it" for each)
expected_behavior: Files each remark as a queue card with queue/item.py before it is posted, one item per message
Says in one line where each goes: the blur remark belongs to spec 27, the billing area is a decision for a new spec
Records each decision only after the owner's explicit word
For the blur remark runs plan/milestone.py add <release> 27 "<Name>" --decision D<n>, which adds the next module, a task file and a milestone to spec 27, and tells the runner with one NOTE line
Does not add the billing work to spec 27; it stays a decision in To do until an epic and a go
Edits no spec file, task file or status by hand

query: (builder in a milestone worktree of a format 2.0 release) Task 27-06 is built. Its Verification list has three ticked boxes and one open box: "- [ ] Owner: the blur strength looks right against the page." Finish the task.
expected_behavior: Runs status/status.py <release> set 27-06 done and does not edit the status line of the task file by hand
Does not tick the Owner: box and does not open a browser for it
Ends with the task stored as blocked with the reason "waits for the owner's look", never as done
Reports that the task waits for the owner's look, with what the owner should look at
Leaves the last step to the lead: after the owner's word the lead ticks the box and sets the task done
